verdict.rationale: Adding and editing codes is documented only through the app UI: QR scan, manual setup-key entry, long-press edit, and manual file import. Ente's CLI is documented and packaged only for exporting and decrypting data, not for creating or updating entries. No API spec was found, and the only deep link is for search, so there is no documented programmatic write surface an agent could use.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, an agent can create and update vault entries — seeding new TOTP secrets, storing credentials — through documented programmatic surfaces
